outcome: Mail, files, sites and chat backed up separately from the platform, so a mailbox can be brought back on your own timeline.
overview: Most organisations take it for granted that their productivity suite is backed up because the provider is large and reputable, and that belief survives until someone needs a mailbox from eighteen months ago. The provider protects its own platform; retention of a deleted item, recovery from a user error, and long-term legal retention are the customer’s responsibility under the shared-responsibility model. Veeam for Microsoft 365 takes independent copies of mail, files, sites and chat into storage the customer controls, which is what makes them recoverable on the customer’s terms.

benefits.text: Independent copies of mail, files, sites and chat are held in storage the customer controls
benefits.limits: The service provider protects its platform, not the customer’s data against the customer’s own errors and retention limits; that boundary is what this record addresses and it should be stated rather than implied

benefits.text: Retention can exceed the platform’s own limits for legal and regulatory obligations
benefits.limits: Long retention has a storage cost that grows continuously; the retention policy should be set from the obligation rather than from a default

benefits.text: Granular recovery of an item or a mailbox is possible without a platform support case
benefits.limits: Backup success rate is not recoverability; only a tested restore against a stated objective evidences it, and the two are routinely substituted for one another

residency: Copies land in storage the customer chooses, including in-country object storage or on-premises repositories

notFor.situation: A tenant already protected by an equivalent independent backup
notFor.why: Two independent copies of the same tenant duplicates storage cost without improving recoverability

notFor.situation: An organisation whose retention obligations are fully met by native platform retention
notFor.why: The gap this addresses may not exist for them

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering with an accredited Veeam implementation partner · Duration: 3–5 weeks to a protected tenant with a first tested recovery
Support model: Vendor subscription support; Redington coordinates the vendor case. Optional managed recovery testing.
1) Review — shared-responsibility position, retention obligations, workload coverage map
2) Design — repository location and sizing, retention policy, permission scoping
3) Deploy — copies running across all covered workload types
4) Test and hand over — first granular recovery tested, schedule handed over

A granular item recovery completes without a platform support case
Repository location matches the recorded residency decision
